heavy_slash_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 120 DMG and 80 to adjacent enemies.

honed_edge_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 50 DMG. Gain ARMOR equal to damage dealt.

intimidate_card.DESCRIPTION: Apply 1 VULNERABLE to all enemies. EPHEMERAL.

war_armor_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 80 ARMOR. SHARPEN an attack in your hand.

whet_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 40 ARMOR. SHARPEN all attacks in your hand.

sweeping_wave_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 70 DMG to all enemies. Gain 5 RAGE.

beserkers_fury_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 100 DMG. Deal 10 additional DMG for each Rage you have.

shield_bash_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal DMG equal to your current ARMOR.

divine_guard_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 60 ARMOR. Add a SMITE to your hand.

holy_beam_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 40 DMG to all enemies. Add a SMITE to your hand.

support_fire_card.DESCRIPTION: The next 2 times you deal DMG with a card, deal 20 DMG with a 50% CRIT CHANCE.

discharge_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 50 DMG. Gain 3 STORM this turn

hidden_slice_card.DESCRIPTION: MULTISTRIKE 2. Deal 30 DMG. Play this for free when discarded.

dodge_past_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 70 ARMOR. Play this for free when discarded.

parrying_dagger_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 50 ARMOR. Your next attack card has +50% CRIT CHANCE.

shock_armor_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 40 ARMOR. Gain 2 STORM this turn.

wild_barrage_card.DESCRIPTION: MULTISTRIKE 2. Deal 20 DMG to all enemies.

bladed_blow_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 70 DMG with a 70% CRIT CHANCE.

magic_missile_card.DESCRIPTION: MULTISTRIKE 3. Deal 45 DMG. Each time, deal DMG to a random enemy.

mage_armor_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 60 ARMOR. Add a MANA CRYSTAL to your hand.

eldritch_blast_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 70 DMG, add a MANA CRYSTAL to your hand and a MANA BURN to your deck.

divination_card.DESCRIPTION: Draw 4 cards. Put a card from your hand on top of your deck

arcane_insight_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 3 EMPOWERED and 40 ARMOR. Add a MANA BURN to your deck.

omenshield_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 75 ARMOR. Put a card from your hand on top of your deck.

channel_card.DESCRIPTION: Add 2 MANA CRYSTAL to your hand.

song_of_protection_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 60 ARMOR. Distribute 4 SYMPHONY randomly among cards in your hand.

song_of_wrath_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 80 DMG to all enemies. Add 2 SYMPHONY to a card in your hand.

tear_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 40 DMG to all enemies apply 2 BLEED.

blood_writing_card.DESCRIPTION: Draw 2 cards and gain 6 RITUAL. Lose 20 HP.

drain_card.DESCRIPTION: Apply 1 VULNERABLE and 1 WEAKENED. Discard a card.

miasmic_armor_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 70 ARMOR. Deal 30 DMG to all enemies.

deaths_call_card.DESCRIPTION: UNPLAYABLE. Deals 10 DMG to you on turn end, then is removed from combat.

rot_card.DESCRIPTION: UNPLAYABLE. Deals 40 DMG to you on turn end, then is discarded.

bash_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 50 DMG. Gain 50 ARMOR and 5 RAGE.

armaments_card.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you play a card, gain 20 ARMOR for each time it's been SHARPENED.

grind_card.DESCRIPTION: SHARPEN an attack in your hand 3 times.

hardened_blades_card.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you SHARPEN, SHARPEN 1 additional time.

unyield_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 50 ARMOR and 5 RAGE. Move Beserker Fury to your hand.

breaching_shield_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 70 ARMOR. Your next card is free to play.

blast_zone_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 130 DMG and 100 to adjacent enemies. Apply 1 VULNERABLE to all hit enemies.

stagger_card.DESCRIPTION: DAZED enemies take 15% more DMG and deal an additional 10% less DMG.

critical_strike_card.DESCRIPTION: SHARPEN this card once for each DAZE on the enemy. Deal 60 DMG.

skull_smash_card.DESCRIPTION: Deal 60 DMG and 30 to adjacent enemies. Apply 1 DAZE to all hit enemies.

deep_impact_card.DESCRIPTION: Apply 2 DAZE. If the enemy already has DAZE, apply 4 additional DAZE.

aggression_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 7 RAGE at the start of each turn.

heavy_axe_card.DESCRIPTION: Gain 5 RAGE. Beserker Fury now applies 2 DAZE.

invigoration_card.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you play a card with base cost 2 or more, gain 40 ARMOR and 1 EMPOWERED.

slicer_rain_card.DESCRIPTION: Use all your remaining energy. Deal 80 Magic DMG that many times.

mana_storm_card.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you play a card this turn, deal 10 Magic DMG to all enemies.

omnipotence_card.DESCRIPTION: Ephemeral. Add 6 Mana Crystals to your hand.

stardust_greatsword.DESCRIPTION: Deal 100 DMG. Deals an additional 60 Magic DMG for each Mana Crystal played this game.

torment_card.DESCRIPTION: Deals 24 Cold DMG for each Insanity you have.

song_of_power.DESCRIPTION: All enemies deal 30% less DMG for 2 turns. Gain 300 Armor.

song_of_life.DESCRIPTION: Deal 60% more final DMG for 4 turns.

song_of_wrath.DESCRIPTION: Multistrike 4. Deal 60 Magic DMG to all enemies.

iron_helm_item.DESCRIPTION: The first time you gain ARMOR each turn, increase that amount by 20%.

whetstone_item.DESCRIPTION: SHARPEN all attacks in your opening hand.

heros_hilt_item.DESCRIPTION: Deal 70 DMG to all enemies on battle start.

heavy_gauntlet_item.DESCRIPTION: Cards with base cost 2 or more apply 1 DAZE.

kite_shield_item.DESCRIPTION: The first time you gain RAGE each turn, gain 40 ARMOR.

caltrops_item.DESCRIPTION: Attacking with a SHARPENED card applies 1 WEAKENED.

potion_of_flame_item.DESCRIPTION: The first time you deal DMG to a single enemy each turn, deal half that DMG to each other enemy.

claymore_item.DESCRIPTION: Add 2 Thrusts to your deck on battle start. VULNERABLE enemies take 25% more DMG.

cloud_smasher_item.DESCRIPTION: Cards with base cost 2 or more cost 1 less to play.

bloodied_axe_item.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you gain RAGE, SHARPEN Beserker Fury.

star_fists_item.DESCRIPTION: DAZE does 100% more DMG. Apply 1 DAZE to each enemy on battle start.

forge_hammer_item.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you SHARPEN, deal 30 DMG to a random enemy and apply 1 DAZE.

bearclaw_item.DESCRIPTION: Deal 30% more DMG. Whenever you play a non-attack card, discard a card.

crushing_gauntlets_item.DESCRIPTION: On turn start, lose 4 RAGE. If you can do so, apply 2 DAZE to a random enemy.

forgotten_lance_item.DESCRIPTION: When you end your turn with no ARMOR, gain 60 ARMOR.

assault_gear_item.DESCRIPTION: Your first attack each turn deals 40% more DMG.

target_dummy_item.DESCRIPTION: Cards with "Strike" in their name deal 20% more DMG.

heros_glove_item.DESCRIPTION: Draw two additional cards on battle start.

raven_feather_item.DESCRIPTION: Gain 10 additional GOLD after each combat.

heros_crest_item.DESCRIPTION: On battle start items trigger an additional time.

follow_up.DESCRIPTION: An attack triggered by an effect rather than played directly.

daze.DESCRIPTION: Dazed enemies deal 20% less DMG and take 30 DMG on turn start.

bleed.DESCRIPTION: Deals 10 DMG on turn start for each BLEED, then loses 1 BLEED.

mana_crystal.DESCRIPTION: A 0 cost card. Adds 1 Energy next turn.

storm.DESCRIPTION: Adds 8 DMG per STORM to each attack.

ephemeral.DESCRIPTION: Playing this card removes it from your deck until the end of combat.

inspiration.DESCRIPTION: Once inspiration reaches 10, resets and adds a powerful card to your hand.

ritual.DESCRIPTION: Enemies take 2% more DMG for each RITUAL. At 20 RITUAL, lose all RITUAL and deal 100 DMG to all enemies.

resonance.DESCRIPTION: After casting, casts all cards with Resonance in your discard pile.

rage.DESCRIPTION: The first time you gain Rage, add Beserker Fury into your Hand.

sharpen.DESCRIPTION: Deals 25% more damage for each time its been sharpened this combat.

fragile.DESCRIPTION: If this isn't played by turn end, it is removed from your deck until the end of combat.

prayer.DESCRIPTION: 1 PRAYER is converted to BLESSING on turn start.

blessing.DESCRIPTION: Deal 10% more DMG for each BLESSING.

resolve.DESCRIPTION: When ARMOR resets, retains 10 ARMOR for each RESOLVE, then lose 1 RESOLVE.

light.DESCRIPTION: Does not take up space in your hand for max hand size.

symphony.DESCRIPTION: When you play a card with SYMPHONY, remove all SYMPHONY and add 20 DMG to an end of turn attack.

corrupted.DESCRIPTION: Gains 20% less ARMOR and takes 20% more DMG.

bleed_status.DESCRIPTION: Deals {10*STACKS} on turn start, then loses 1 BLEED.

support_fire_status.DESCRIPTION: After dealing DMG with a card, launches follow-up: Deal 50 Physical DMG and apply 2 daze.

thorned_armor_status.DESCRIPTION: After losing any Armor, launches follow-up: Deal 30 Physical DMG.

daze_status.DESCRIPTION: Deal 20% less DMG. Takes 30 DMG on turn start.

storm_status.DESCRIPTION: After dealing damage, launches follow-up: Deal {8*STACKS} Lightning DMG.

gelatinous_status.DESCRIPTION: Splits into two smaller slimes upon reaching half HP.

thieving_status.DESCRIPTION: Takes {STACKS} Gold upon attacking you. Returns half of stolen gold upon death.

towering_shield_status.DESCRIPTION: Gaining ARMOR also gives allies that much ARMOR.

healing_rune_status.DESCRIPTION: If this doesn't take damage with {STACKS} turns, it heals 50 HP.

armaments_status.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you play a card, gain {20*STACKS} ARMOR for each time it's been sharpened.

hardened_blades_status.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you SHARPEN, SHARPEN {STACKS} additional time. Ephemeral.

next_card_free_status.DESCRIPTION: Your next card is free to play.

stagger_status.DESCRIPTION: DAZED enemies take {15*STACKS}% more DMG and deal {10*STACKS}% less DMG.

aggression_status.DESCRIPTION: Gain {4*STACKS} at the start of each turn.

invigoration_status.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you play a card with base cost 2 or more, gain 40 ARMOR and 1 EMPOWERED.

grievous_wounds_status.DESCRIPTION: Deal {10*STACKS} additional flat damage for each WOUND in your deck.

prayer_status.DESCRIPTION: Converts to 1 BLESSING on turn end.

resolve_status.DESCRIPTION: Keeps up to {10*STACKS} ARMOR between turns. Loses 1 RESOLVE on turn start.

parrying_dagger_status.DESCRIPTION: Your next attack card has a bonus 50% CRIT CHANCE.

symphony_status.DESCRIPTION: Deals {20*STACKS} to all enemies on turn end, then loses all SYMPHONY.

ritual_status.DESCRIPTION: Enemies take {2*STACKS}% more DMG. At 20 RITUAL, lose all RITUAL and deal 100 DMG to all enemies.

corrupted_status.DESCRIPTION: Gains 20% less ARMOR and takes 20% more DMG.
